content_audit.scope: first-party root instruction files and root .agents skill files only
content_audit.not_read_reason: duplicated worktrees, vendored references, or dependency trees; inventory remains exhaustive

at_import_examples.interpretation: package specifier, not a local file reference

suggested_reference_rules: Parse Markdown link destinations and resolve relative targets against the containing instruction file; retain line and source path.
Recognize @ tokens as local includes only when they are path-like or an exact instruction basename such as @AGENTS.md; exclude package scopes such as @devcontainers/cli@latest.
Scan inline code and shell blocks for repo-relative paths, dot-directories, filenames with known extensions, and globs; preserve placeholders and command context.
Scan prose for path-like tokens with slash or a known file extension, while excluding URLs, route paths, branch names, package names, and ordinary words.
Keep home-relative paths such as ~/.t3 separate from repository-local references and never resolve them against the repository root.
Resolve each reference relative to its source document, but deduplicate repeated content by file identity or hash across generated worktrees and dependency trees.
